_comment: Runtime configuration for the published WASM bundle. Both values match the fallbacks compiled into Program.cs, so `dotnet run` behaves exactly as before. The file must exist at PUBLISH time to be registered in the Blazor boot manifest — the container entrypoint rewrites it from $API_BASE_URL and $ARK_NETWORK so one image can serve any environment.
_comment_network: Which Ark network the IN-BROWSER wallet dials (arkd + esplora): regtest | mutinynet | mainnet. An unknown value throws rather than defaulting — a wallet silently on the wrong network puts player funds out of reach.
